summary: Comprehensive testing of Audit Trail feature (Companies Act 2013 Rule 3(1) compliance) and branding changes. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). All 10 frontend UI tests passed (100%). Audit trail is fully functional with append-only design, field-level change tracking, CSV export, and proper filtering.
test_credentials: No authentication required - all endpoints are public
seed_data_creation: Created 1 PO (LANXESS India, RM-MDI) during backend testing. Updated company settings to test field-level change logging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit Trail feature fully tested and working. 4 audit entries exist in DB (2 Company Settings updates, 2 PO creates). All audit trail APIs working: GET /api/audit-trail (with filters), /stats, /document-types, /export. No edit/delete endpoints exist (tamper-proof). Branding updated to KAIROS / AI ERP. Global AI bar hidden on /reporting-ai page.

audit_trail_api_get.details: GET /api/audit-trail returns entries with filters (document_type, action, date_from, date_to, search). Pagination working with limit/skip.

audit_trail_api_stats.details: GET /api/audit-trail/stats returns total_entries, by_action counts, by_document_type counts, latest_entry.

audit_trail_api_document_types.details: GET /api/audit-trail/document-types returns distinct document types for filter dropdown.

audit_trail_api_export.details: GET /api/audit-trail/export returns CSV file with proper headers (Timestamp, User, Action, Document Type, Document Number, Document ID, Changes, Notes).

audit_trail_po_logging.details: Creating a PO logs audit entry with action=CREATE, document_type=Purchase Order, includes full document snapshot.

audit_trail_field_changes.details: Updating company settings logs field-level changes (old_value -> new_value) for each modified field.

audit_trail_tamper_proof.details: No DELETE, PUT, or PATCH endpoints exist for audit trail. All return 404/405. Append-only design verified.

audit_trail_ui_page.details: Audit Trail page loads with stats cards (4 total, 2 UPDATE, 2 CREATE), filters section, table, and Export CSV button.

audit_trail_ui_expandable_rows.details: Clicking audit row expands to show field-level changes diff (before -> after) with color-coded old/new values.

branding_kairos_ai_erp.details: Sidebar header shows 'KAIROS' and 'AI ERP' (not 'Advisory'). KairosIcon SVG renders correctly.

kairos_icon_svg.details: KairosIcon SVG renders in sidebar header and ReportingAI page header.

global_ai_bar_hidden_on_reporting_ai.details: Global AI prompt bar (UniversalAI) is hidden on /reporting-ai page to avoid overlap with page's own chat input.

reporting_ai_input_clickable.details: ReportingAI chat input is clickable and accepts text input without overlap issues.
